root_causes: functional code generation does not imply secure generation
existing_solutions: SAST/DAST, review, threat modeling
expected_benefits: make security checks explicit
limitations: benchmark task distribution may differ from real projects
validation_strategy: security fixture suite with known CWEs
source_title: Veracode 2026 GenAI Code Security Report

description: The 2025 report found detectable OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities in 45% of tested generated-code cases.
root_causes: security is not guaranteed by syntactic correctness
existing_solutions: security scanners and manual review
expected_benefits: prevent shipping syntactically valid but unsafe code
limitations: vendor-authored benchmark; reproduce with open fixtures where possible
validation_strategy: known-vulnerability fixture suite
source_title: Veracode 2025 GenAI Code Security Report

description: A public-GitHub analysis reported 4,241 CWE instances across 7,703 AI-attributed files.
root_causes: generated code can carry real-world vulnerability patterns
existing_solutions: CodeQL and language-specific secure coding
expected_benefits: prioritize real CWE classes
limitations: AI attribution and repository selection can be noisy
validation_strategy: replicate selected checks on public fixtures
source_title: Security Vulnerabilities in AI-Generated Code: A Large-Scale Analysis of Public GitHub Repositories

description: In a manually reviewed subset, ChatGPT detected 18 of 32 confirmed vulnerabilities and fixed 17; 22 vulnerabilities were introduced by ChatGPT rather than prompts.
affected_developers: developers using LLMs for security-sensitive code
root_causes: same model that generates defects may incompletely review them
existing_solutions: independent scanners and manual review
expected_benefits: avoid self-certification by the generator alone
limitations: small manually reviewed subset
validation_strategy: independent static-analysis verification
source_title: Secure Coding with AI, From Creation to Inspection

description: DORA reported AI adoption positively related to throughput/product performance but negatively related to delivery stability.
root_causes: higher change volume exposes weak testing and feedback systems
existing_solutions: automated testing, version control, fast feedback
expected_benefits: make AI speed conditional on stability controls
limitations: correlation does not prove causation
validation_strategy: compare defect escape/stability on fixed CI fixtures
source_title: 2025 DORA Report announcement

description: A randomized study of experienced open-source developers found tasks took 19% longer with early-2025 AI tools in that setting.
affected_developers: experienced developers on mature familiar repos
root_causes: review/interaction overhead can outweigh generation speed
existing_solutions: selective AI use and measurable workflows
expected_benefits: optimize for task success and time, not amount of AI use
limitations: authors explicitly warn against generalizing to all developers/tasks
validation_strategy: benchmark end-to-end elapsed work on controlled tasks
source_title: Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity

description: METR later reported selection effects and weak evidence of improved speedup, especially with more concurrent agent use.
root_causes: concurrency changes measurement and workflow coordination
existing_solutions: task ownership and integration review
expected_benefits: make parallelism auditable
limitations: selection bias prevents strong causal estimate
validation_strategy: measure overlap/conflicts in parallel fixture tasks
source_title: METR update on developer productivity experiment design

description: Across 36,870 upgrade recommendations, 27.76% referenced nonexistent versions before live repository grounding.
affected_developers: developers using AI for dependency upgrades
root_causes: package ecosystems change faster than model knowledge
existing_solutions: live registries and lockfile-aware tools
expected_benefits: eliminate invented versions through grounding
limitations: dataset comes from vendor methodology
validation_strategy: compare recommendations to live/local package metadata
source_title: 2026 Sonatype Software Supply Chain Report — Grounded AI Agents

description: GitHub documents that Copilot may miss code-quality problems and may hallucinate false-positive review comments.
root_causes: LLM review is fallible in both directions
existing_solutions: human review and independent checks
expected_benefits: require evidence before accepting review findings
limitations: applies to GitHub Copilot and may not transfer exactly
validation_strategy: seed true/false defects and measure precision/recall
source_title: GitHub Copilot Agents — responsible use and limitations

description: OpenAI describes prompt injection as third-party content misleading an agent into actions the user did not request.
root_causes: untrusted data can be interpreted as instructions
existing_solutions: least privilege, approvals, isolation
expected_benefits: reduce authority confusion
limitations: instruction-only defenses are incomplete
validation_strategy: malicious-content fixtures with protected actions
source_title: OpenAI — Understanding prompt injections

description: A 2026 Codex Desktop issue reports repeated tool calls continuing without task progress.
root_causes: missing no-progress stop condition
existing_solutions: manual cancellation and restart
expected_benefits: detect repeated identical actions before waste escalates
limitations: single issue report; cause may be product-specific
validation_strategy: synthetic repeated-tool-call transcript
source_title: Codex Desktop enters an infinite loop of repeated tool calls

description: A 2026 Codex issue reports slow/failing MCP startup, queue saturation, and hundreds of descendant processes under many loaded threads.
affected_developers: Codex users with many MCP servers/threads
root_causes: eager startup and retry behavior can couple unrelated workflows
existing_solutions: timeouts, lazy loading, health checks
expected_benefits: surface startup cost and failure isolation
limitations: complex environment and no minimal reproduction
validation_strategy: local fake MCP servers with controlled delays/failures
source_title: Codex Desktop app-server stalls with MCP startup load

description: A 2026 Codex issue reports an infinite cmd/node process spawn loop associated with a bundled plugin MCP startup path.
root_causes: handshake retry loops can multiply processes
existing_solutions: disable failing plugin, add startup circuit breaker
expected_benefits: detect runaway child-process growth
limitations: product-specific implementation
validation_strategy: fake failing MCP with process-count guard
source_title: Codex Windows bundled plugin causes cmd/node spawn loop

description: A 2026 Codex issue reports tool calls stalling for hours while turns wait for tool results.
root_causes: tool dispatch/completion signaling can deadlock or fail silently
existing_solutions: timeouts, cancellation, health probes
expected_benefits: require bounded waits and observable failure
limitations: single environment; root cause not fully isolated
validation_strategy: fake tool that never returns plus timeout/cancel assertion
source_title: Codex Windows tool calls can stall for hours

description: A Roo Code issue reports false-positive loop detection when repeated MCP calls are making measurable progress.
root_causes: naive repetition heuristics ignore state progress
existing_solutions: progress-aware loop detection
expected_benefits: avoid both infinite loops and premature aborts
limitations: issue is specific to one loop detector
validation_strategy: paired fixtures: identical-no-progress vs repeated-progress
source_title: Roo Code loop detection false positives on MCP tools

description: An Aider issue reports benchmark tests left disabled or skipped, undermining execution coverage.
root_causes: test presence can be mistaken for test execution
existing_solutions: fail on skipped critical tests; inspect runner output
expected_benefits: separate test files from tests actually run
limitations: open issue may reflect a transient benchmark bug
validation_strategy: fixture with skipped tests and expected executed-test count
source_title: Aider polyglot benchmark leaves tests skipped

description: A Cline issue reports session-not-found behavior, illustrating continuity failures across coding sessions.
root_causes: session state can disappear or become inaccessible
existing_solutions: repo-local handoff state
expected_benefits: make progress recoverable from repository evidence
limitations: product-specific bug and sparse public detail
validation_strategy: interrupt/resume fixture using only repository artifacts
source_title: Cline session not found issue

description: A Roo Code issue reports structural API errors retried indefinitely without a circuit breaker.
root_causes: retries occur without classifying permanent vs transient failures
existing_solutions: retry budgets and error classification
expected_benefits: bound repeated failures and protect conversation history
limitations: single issue report
validation_strategy: permanent-error fixture asserting bounded attempts
source_title: Roo Code structural API error retries forever
